# Sold It Today

> Sold It Today is a Southeast Michigan real estate team led by Charlotte Hypes (REALTOR, Team Leader), brokered by Remerica United Realty in Novi, MI. With 20 years of experience and 350+ homes sold (Top 5% Agent, Homesnap 2022), the team specializes in first-time buyers, down payment assistance, and credit guidance across Downriver and Metro Detroit.

## About
- Agent: Charlotte Hypes, REALTOR, Team Leader
- Brokerage: Remerica United Realty, 47720 Grand River Ave, Novi, MI 48374
- Phone: 313-529-5750
- Website: https://www.soldittoday.com
- Instagram: @sold.it.today
- Specialties: first-time home buyers, down payment assistance, credit guidance, buyers, sellers, relocation
- Credentials: 20 years experience, 350+ homes sold, Top 5% Agent

## Service area
Downriver and Metro Detroit, across Wayne, Oakland, Macomb, Washtenaw, and Livingston counties. Cities served include Taylor, Wyandotte, Lincoln Park, Southgate, Allen Park, Woodhaven, Flat Rock, Riverview, Trenton, Grosse Ile, Brownstown Township, Romulus, Belleville, Huron Township, Livonia, Dearborn, Dearborn Heights, Westland, Garden City, Canton, Plymouth, Northville, Redford, Detroit, Novi, Pontiac, Milford, Farmington, Farmington Hills, West Bloomfield, Commerce Township, South Lyon, Franklin, Southfield, Warren, Sterling Heights, Eastpointe, Ypsilanti, and Howell.
